issues.description: Condition could be more idiomatic using node.nodes presence check
issues.detail: The check `typeof node.nodes === 'undefined'` works but is slightly unusual. `!node.nodes` or `node.nodes == null` would be more idiomatic in this codebase. Minor style point; the current form is correct since PostCSS sets `nodes` to an array for container nodes and leaves it undefined otherwise.

issues.description: Missing test case for empty layer block edge case `@layer foo { }`
issues.detail: The added test uses `@layer foo {}` (no whitespace inside). It would be worth also verifying behavior with whitespace/comments inside the block, e.g. `@layer foo { /* comment */ }`, to ensure PostCSS still parses `nodes` as defined and the rule triggers consistently.

issues.description: No test for valid case: layer statement (no block) before import should still pass
issues.detail: The PR adds a reject test for layer-with-block before import but doesn't add a corresponding accept test confirming that statement-form `@layer foo;` before `@import` is still allowed. There may be an existing test covering this, but adding/verifying one would lock in the intended distinction.

issues.description: Consider testing multiple layer names with block form
issues.detail: `@layer foo, bar { ... }` is invalid syntax, but `@layer foo { @import ... }` nested cases or layer blocks containing rules could be worth a quick test to confirm the walker's behavior. Low priority since the fix scope is narrow.

review.summary: Small, well-scoped bug fix that correctly distinguishes layer statements (allowed before `@import`) from layer blocks (which should trigger the rule). The implementation using `typeof node.nodes === 'undefined'` is correct given PostCSS semantics, and the added test case directly mirrors the reported issue. No correctness or security concerns; only minor style and test-coverage suggestions. Safe to merge.
